projector.domain_condition: integral_0^1 N0 a0^4 u1 delta_sigma_perp dt=0
projector.normalization: integral_0^1 N0 a0^4 u1^2 dt=1 per cap
projector.projector: P_perp f=f-u1 integral_0^1 N0 a0^4 u1 f dt
projector.source_projection: J_sigma is replaced by P_perp J_sigma

source.J0: J0[Y]=B0_metric(v_metric,Y_metric)+B0_scalar(s u1,delta_sigma_perp); the scalar term is zero and the metric functional includes its B1 boundary distribution
source.J1: J1[Y]=B1_metric(v_metric,Y_metric)-2Z5 integral N0 a0^2(s u1)delta_sigma_perp dt+integral w[J_A A+J_psi_derivative partial_t psi]dt

K_direct.K0: B0_metric(v,v)+B0_scalar(su1,su1); the scalar term vanishes by the critical Jacobi equation
K_direct.K1: B1_metric(v,v)-2Z5 integral N0 a0^2 u1^2 dt+2 integral w[J_A v_A+J_psi_derivative partial_t v_psi]dt
K_direct.pure_shift_square: zero after the parent constraint: the shift Hessian is a quadratic form in W=B+tau(pi chi_1/16)tq and W=0

source.affine_convention: Y_total=Y_response+q v with v=(N1/N0,a1/a0,s u1); independent M4 h is varied and no separate X-metric tangent is added

profiles.sigma_q: s u1(t), with <u1,u1>_(N0 a0^4)=1 per cap

threading.endpoint_after_radial_IBP: [w J_psi_derivative psi]_(0,1); retained with the B1 source
